# SMS Alert

SMS Alert is a versatile multi-channel communication platform enabling businesses to engage with customers through SMS, RCS, Telegram, and WhatsApp via a unified REST API.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/sms-alert/.

## Actions

- **Create New Contact**: Create new contact
- **Create New Group**: Create a new contact group.
- **Create Short URL**: Create a short url for a given long url.
- **Delete Contact**: Delete a specified contact.
- **Delete Group**: Delete a specified group.
- **Delete Short URL**: Delete an existing short url.
- **Delete SMS Template**: Delete an existing sms template.
- **Edit Contact**: Edit an existing contact’s details.
- **Edit Group**: Edit an existing groups name.
- **Edit SMS Template**: Edit an existing sms template.
- **Generate OTP**: Generate a one-time password (otp).
- **Get Group Detail** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific sms alert group.
- **Get Group List** (read-only): Retrieve a list of sms alert groups.
- **Get Sender ID List** (read-only): Fetch the list of available sender ids.
- **Get Sent SMS Report** (read-only): Retrieve sms campaign sent report details.
- **Get SMS Alert Balance** (read-only): Retrieve the current sms credit balance.
- **Get SMS Template List** (read-only): Retrieve list of sms templates from your smsalert account.
- **Update User Profile**: Update user account profile details.
- **Create SMS Template**: Create a new sms template.
